entry.title: Summer Wind Relay
entry.synopsis:
A coastal high school's relay team has four runners, three shoes and one summer to qualify.

Nobody on the team has ever won anything, unless the school lost-and-found raffle counts. Captain Mio Haraki counts it twice a day.

The first practice is a disaster. The baton ends up in the harbour, the stopwatch in the vending machine, and the coach, who is also the music teacher, in a very long argument with a seagull about the rules of lane eight.

Over the weeks that follow the four of them learn each other's strides, excuses and favourite convenience-store snacks. They also learn that the shoes fit best in turns, which makes the baton pass a small act of trust and an even smaller act of comedy.

Then the regional heats are moved a week earlier, the harbour floods the track, and the team has to find out what they are good at before they find out what they are up against.

Whatever happens at the finish line, the summer wind has already decided which of them it will carry home first.

v1.title: Stardust Wayfarer
v1.synopsis:
A lamplighter with no memory of her home walks the old star roads, relighting the beacons that guide travellers between the towns.

Each town she saves remembers a little of her, and she, a little less of herself.
